integrity: The claim is proved by an embedded finite checker, exact integer unit-pivot matrices, and a cellular Hurewicz argument; finite computation is not treated as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact computation/proof only for integer parameters 0<=k<=6; no infinite continuation, shellability, or equivariant character. Unindexed equivalent may exist.
title: First mixed-dimensional two-independence topology in stable two-subset Kneser graphs
